note:
The gates that do not yet carry BOTH a can-pass and a can-fail fixture. THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. An entry is deleted by writing the two fixtures, never by deleting the gate's line from the declaration site. A gate that is not in this list and carries no fixtures FAILS gate_mutation_fixture_check, which is what makes a NEW gate arrive with both directions or not arrive.

EVERY ENTRY USED TO CARRY A `declared_at` OF THE FORM `tools/ci/repo_hygiene_gates.sh:<line>`, AND ALL 72 WERE REMOVED ON 2026-08-25 BECAUSE ALL 72 WERE WRONG. Measured: 0 of 72 pinned lines still contained the gate they named, and the real declarations sat 284 to 500 lines further down. It could not go red -- nothing read the field -- so it rotted silently and would have misdirected the next reader who trusted it. It was a FROZEN COPY of a value the repository computes live: `gate_mutation_fixtures.declarations()` parses the dispatcher with the repo's one parser and returns `GateDecl.lineno` for every gate. A number that has a live source and a frozen copy has one true value and one that is only sometimes true. TO FIND A GATE'S DECLARATION, use the `gate` field, which is the label byte-for-byte: it locates the declaration UNIQUELY for all 72 entries, and `test_no_debt_entry_pins_a_line_number` keeps that true.
